notes:
- Drop-in co-op. A hosted game now stays in the server browser while it's being played (shown as
  "IN GAME", with a DROP IN button). Joiners load straight into the match as it is (the round, open doors,
  boards, the box, the quest so far, the zombies) and watch until the next round starts. Hosts who want
  privacy can turn off Show in browser while playing when hosting.
- New perk: 3rd Hand (teal). Carry a third gun: it gets its own teal slot (key 4) in the weapon bar.
  Upgrade trees: Juggler (faster swaps) and Spare Mags (guns you're not holding reload themselves).
- The Alpha's entrance. The first time it comes, a short cutscene plays (letterbox, it drops in and roars,
  its title card); every zombie holds still meanwhile, and Jump skips it. Once you've beaten it, the Alpha
  comes back every 4-5 rounds on the Outskirts as a mini boss (no cutscene), a bit tougher each time.
- Fixed: the Alpha's health bar said SIR CHONK if a Sir Chonk round had come first.
- The last 2 zombies of a round glow red through walls, and in co-op your **teammates show as a
  silhouette** in their colour through walls.
- Fancier upgrade names: Tier I waves in violet, Tier II burns in flickering fire, Tier III shimmers
  cyan and violet.
- Tier III explosive rounds (pistols, shotguns) now go off on walls and floors too, not only zombies.
- Family Home bedrooms reworked: whole walls only (no more odd stubs around the stairs), wider doorways
  near the corners so zombies don't get stuck, and the bed and furniture laid out to fit the room. Beds no
  longer stand in the open-plan part of the house.
